title: Holidays Around the World
text:
Many people love holidays. In Brazil, people celebrate Carnival in February. They dance in the streets and wear colourful costumes. Carnival is loud and fun.

In Japan, many families celebrate New Year in January. They clean their houses and eat special food together. In the United States, people celebrate Thanksgiving in November. They eat turkey with their family.

questions.text: What do people wear during Carnival in Brazil?
What do many families in Japan do at New Year?
options: They clean their houses and eat special food.
They go skiing in the mountains.

questions.text: How do people probably feel during Carnival?
What can we infer about Thanksgiving?
options: It is a holiday for spending time with family.
It is a holiday only for children.
It is celebrated with dancing in the streets.

paragraph_translations: Muitas pessoas adoram feriados. No Brasil, as pessoas comemoram o Carnaval em fevereiro. Elas dançam nas ruas e usam fantasias coloridas. O Carnaval é animado e divertido.

No Japão, muitas famílias comemoram o Ano Novo em janeiro. Elas limpam suas casas e comem comidas especiais juntas. Nos Estados Unidos, as pessoas comemoram o Dia de Ação de Graças em novembro. Elas comem peru com a família.
